title: RLEF: Grounding Code LLMs in Execution Feedback with Reinforcement Learning

model.params_source: paper Sec. 3.2 and Table 2 caption (temperature 0.2 for 1@3, nucleus sampling top-p 0.95, 20 rollouts per problem); max_tokens assumed

task.approximation: Sandbox time/memory limits and the set of executed tests may differ from the authors' setup; 20 samples per problem as in the paper.

prompt.user_template:
Provide a Python solution for the following competitive programming question: {problem}.
Your code should be enclosed in triple backticks like so: ```python YOUR CODE HERE ```. Use the backticks for your code only.

placeholders.problem: items.description inserted as-is (Appendix C.1: '${problem}' is replaced by the original problem description)

prompt.verbatim: full (the extraction rendered the triple backticks as curly quotes; restored)

output.parse: regex ```python\n(.*?)``` (first fenced block) -> program; executed as Python 3 against the tests
output.postprocess: no fenced block counted as a failed sample

metric.name: custom
metric.definition: 1@3 solve rate: with 20 samples per problem, the unbiased estimator of Li et al. (2022) for the probability that a submission chosen from 3 random samples solves the problem (a sample solves it if it passes all private and generated tests; public tests are used only to select the submission), averaged over the 165 problems (x100).
metric.original_location: Table 2, row gpt-4o-2024-05-13, column CC. Test ST (single-turn)

open_points: Scoring needs an execution sandbox (per-test timeout, memory limit) to run 3,300 generated programs against the private and generated tests; no code execution in the runner or hooks.

1@3 needs 20 samples per problem (seeds = 20 in the runner's terms, ~$50) and the Li et al. (2022) estimator; confirm the interpretation for the single-turn baseline (filter by public tests then one submission, as configured, versus pass@3).
notes: Problem statements average ~1k tokens; only the test parquet (one file) is needed. || [hook pass 2026-09-07] no hook: execution sandbox.
